definitions.gloss: one united body; unity; acting as one
definitions.explanation: A group acting together with a single purpose. Almost always appears in the fixed pattern {一丸|いちがん}となる ("to become as one") or {一丸|いちがん}となって ("acting as one").

examples.japanese: チームは{一丸|いちがん}となった。
examples.english: The team came together as one.

examples.japanese: {全社員|ぜんしゃいん}が{一丸|いちがん}となって{目標|もくひょう}に{取|と}り{組|く}んだ。
examples.english: All the employees worked toward the goal as one.

examples.japanese: {被災地|ひさいち}{復興|ふっこう}のため、{地域住民|ちいきじゅうみん}と{自治体|じちたい}が{一丸|いちがん}となって{活動|かつどう}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: To rebuild the disaster-stricken area, local residents and the municipal government are continuing their efforts as one.

notes:
Composed of {一|いち} (one) + {丸|がん} (round mass, ball). Literally "one lump" — a group fused into a single unit.

FIXED PATTERNS:
- {一丸|いちがん}となる: to unite, to come together as one
- {一丸|いちがん}となって: acting as one (adverbial form, by far the most common use)
- 〜が{一丸|いちがん}となる: ~ unite as one

{一丸|いちがん} is essentially bound to the {〜となる} construction; it does not freely combine with other verbs.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {団結|だんけつ}: unity, solidarity — broader noun for being united; can be used freely with する
- {結束|けっそく}: cohesion, solidarity — emphasizes the bond holding the group together
- {結集|けっしゅう}: rallying together — implies gathering forces for a purpose
